metadata.title: The global structure of bi-rotational self-shrinkers
metadata.abstract: We describe the global structure of the self-shrinkers of the mean curvature flow in $\mathbb{R}^{p+q+2}$ invariant under $O(p+1)\times O(q+1)$, without assuming properness or embeddedness. The main tool is a pair of piecewise monotone quantities along the profile curves, in the spirit of Hsiang's analysis of constant mean curvature hypersurfaces. We prove that every such self-shrinker other than the two invariant cylinders intersects both of them transversely, and all of them except the Clifford minimal cone are complete. Apart from those of the cylinders, each end is either asymptotic to a cone or meets both cylinders infinitely many times. Consequently, a complete noncompact example is proper if and only if all its ends are asymptotically conical, and this is equivalent to polynomial volume growth, to finite entropy, and to finitely many intersections with the cylinders. The reduced flow preserves a finite measure, and for almost every initial condition the profile curve is either closed or generates a complete nonproper self-shrinker of infinite entropy. We also bound the winding of the profile curve by its number of cylinder crossings and localize its self-intersections.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 双旋转自收缩子的整体结构
analysis.workSummary: 不预设正常性或嵌入性，分析双旋转自收缩子的轮廓曲线与端部，建立渐近锥、有限熵、多项式体积增长和正常性之间的等价关系。
analysis.breakthrough: 纳入非正常无限熵例子，并给出几乎所有初值的闭轨或非正常二分现象。
analysis.limitations: 存在 Clifford 极小锥及两个圆柱等例外；正常性等价陈述针对文中指定的完备非紧模型类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Claude 与 ChatGPT 辅助语言、组织表述、数值试验、部分论证建议以及讨论核验计算，并逐项人工审阅；数值轨迹不作证明依据。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25831v1 · 第9页 AI statement 及 Data availability

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 Claude 与 ChatGPT 辅助语言、组织表述、数值试验、部分论证建议以及讨论核验计算，并逐项人工审阅；数值轨迹不作证明依据。

analysis.priorityReason: 有助理解常用有限熵假设之外的流奇点模型。
